title: Cold Caller
description:
We are seeking a confident, persistent, and sales-driven **Cold Caller** to drive outbound outreach for a construction and roofing company. This role requires a polished phone presence, strong spoken English, and the ability to follow a script while keeping conversations natural and persuasive. The ideal candidate is comfortable making high-volume calls, handling objections, and keeping an organized lead pipeline in a CRM — all with minimal supervision.



---



## Key Responsibilities



## Outbound Cold Calling & Lead Generation



- Execute daily outbound cold calls to residential homeowners, property managers, apartment complexes, and commercial prospects

- Follow provided scripts while adapting naturally to each conversation to maximize engagement and interest

- Qualify leads based on defined criteria — identifying decision-makers, project needs, timelines, and budget

- Set appointments or warm transfers for the owner to deliver estimates and close deals

- Maintain a high daily call volume with consistent energy and professionalism throughout each shift



## CRM Management & Lead Tracking



- Log all call activity, lead status, and contact notes in the CRM after every interaction

- Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline of verified leads and follow-up schedules

- Flag high-priority leads and hot prospects for the owner’s immediate attention

- Pull daily and weekly call reports to track outreach volume and conversion activity

- Ensure no leads go cold by maintaining a structured follow-up cadence



## Follow-Up & Pipeline Nurturing



- Conduct consistent follow-up calls and messages with leads that did not convert on first contact

- Send follow-up sequences via
 or SMS as directed to keep prospects warm

- Re-engage past leads and dormant contacts from the existing database

- Communicate clearly with the owner on lead quality, objections encountered, and pipeline status



---



## Requirements



## Essential



- Excellent spoken English — clear, natural, confident, and professional on every call

- Proven cold calling or outbound sales experience with a track record of booking appointments or generating qualified leads

- Comfortable handling objections and rejection without losing 
ntum or energy

- Highly self-motivated and able to maintain a strong call volume independently

- Detail-oriented with consistent follow-through on lead tracking and follow-up tasks



## Technical



- Experience with CRM platforms for logging calls, managing pipelines, and tracking leads

- Comfortable using a dialer system for high-volume outbound calling

- Familiarity with basic follow-up tools including
 and SMS outreach platforms

- Ability to learn and work within new systems quickly with minimal setup support



## Preferred



- Previous cold calling experience in construction, roofing, home services, or real estate

- Background in B2B or B2C outbound sales with demonstrated appointment-setting results

- Familiarity with the US construction or insurance restoration industry

- Experience working with county or commercial property contacts



To apply, please send your updated resume with your self-intro. Incomplete application will not be entertained.

title: SharePoint Developer
description:

Job Title: SharePoint Developer

Work Type: 

  Remote/WFH

  Full-time 

Working Hours: TBD (Usually US Hours/Night shift)

Start Date: TBD



JOB OVERVIEW:



The SharePoint Developer is responsible for designing, developing, customizing, migrating, and supporting SharePoint environments for multiple clients. This role focuses on building scalable solutions, improving business processes, and ensuring stable SharePoint performance across diverse customer environments.



JOB ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES: 



Solution Design & Development



Develop SharePoint sites, pages, lists, libraries, workflows, and forms based on

customer requirements.

Build custom SharePoint Framework (SPFx) components, Power Apps, and Power Automate workflows.

Create responsive, user-friendly SharePoint sites for communication, collaboration, and document management.

Integrate SharePoint with other Microsoft 365 services (Teams, OneDrive, Azure AD, etc.).



Support & Maintenance



Provide Tier 2/Tier 3 support for client SharePoint environments on Modern SharePoint Online and legacy on-prem versions.

Troubleshoot permissions issues, workflow failures, site performance problems, and configuration issues.

Perform content migrations using Microsoft and third-party tools.

Monitor health, storage usage, and performance of SharePoint Online tenants.



Client Engagement



Work directly with clients to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

Deliver training or user adoption sessions for SharePoint features and best practices.

Provide recommendations for effective site architecture and governance.

Perform SharePoint migrations (On-premise file server to SharePoint, SharePoint to SharePoint, and SharePoint to Teams).



Documentation & Governance



Maintain documentation for site structures, permissions, workflows, and custom

solutions.

Ensure adherence to governance policies, security standards, and change management procedures.

Develop templates, standards, and repeatable processes to improve consistency across client environments.



Collaboration



Work closely with FMS project managers, systems engineers, and service desk teams.

Coordinate with Microsoft 365 administrators on tenant-level configuration and security.

Participate in onboarding new clients or scoping new SharePoint projects.





JOB REQUIREMENTS:



Required Skills & Experience



Strong experience with SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 ecosystem.

Proficiency in:

   SharePoint Modern experience (sites, lists, libraries)

   SPFx, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS

   Power Platform: Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI (optional)

   REST APIs, Microsoft Graph

Experience with SharePoint migrations and third-party tools.

Understanding of permissions models, content types, metadata, site columns, and hub site architecture.

Ability to manage multiple client environments and priorities simultaneously.



Preferred Qualifications



Microsoft 365 or SharePoint-related certifications.

Experience in a multi-tenant MSP environment.

Familiarity with Azure AD, conditional access, and security fundamentals.

Knowledge of information governance, compliance, and lifecycle management.



Success Indicators



High client satisfaction through reliable delivery and proactive recommendations.

Efficient project execution with minimal escalations.

Well-structured, scalable SharePoint sites and workflows that reduce client workload.

Detailed documentation and adherence to governance standards.

title: Client Growth & Success Specialist (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
Job Title: Client Growth & Success Specialist (Full-Time, Remote)

Location: Remote

Salary: 86,412.13 PHP per month + 5,000 PHP sign-on bonus + quarterly performance bonuses after probation



About us

We are a North American digital marketing agency that works exclusively with lash extension businesses across the United States and Canada. We run paid advertising, lead generation, and end-to-end booking operations for approximately 50 lash studio owners. We cover our clients' ad spend, manage their leads, and book appointments on their behalf — all for a flat weekly fee.

We are a fast-growing, results-driven company that holds itself to a high standard. Every person on our team has a direct impact on client outcomes and company growth. We invest in our people and we pay well because we expect a lot.



About This Role

This is a full-time remote position that combines two functions: inbound discovery sales and client success management. You will be working directly with our founder and leadership team.

This is not a traditional sales role. You will not be cold calling or doing outbound prospecting. Prospective clients have already expressed interest in our services before speaking with you. Your job is to walk them through what we do, assess whether they are a good fit, and connect qualified prospects with our Lash Growth Specialist for the next step.

Alongside that, you will be managing relationships with our existing clients — answering their questions, reviewing their performance reports on Zoom, handling their concerns, and most importantly, overcoming objections from clients who are frustrated or uncertain. This part of the role requires emotional intelligence, composure, and the ability to stay calm and professional when a client is upset.



Schedule

Monday to Friday



9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Mountain Standard Time (MST)



30-minute unpaid lunch break



Two 15-minute breaks per day

You must be fully available and online during all working hours. Please verify the MST time zone against your local time before applying. Late starts, early finishes, and unexplained absences will not be tolerated.



What You Will Be Doing

Discovery Calls



Get on Zoom calls with prospective clients who have reached out to learn about Swoop Lift

Introduce yourself and explain our services clearly and confidently

Assess whether the prospect is a qualified fit for our program

Book a follow-up call with our Lash Growth Specialist for qualified prospects

Handle any objections the prospect raises calmly and professionally



Client Success Management



Respond promptly and professionally to existing client questions via WhatsApp and other channels

Get on Zoom calls with clients to review their monthly performance reports

Handle client concerns and complaints with empathy and composure

Overcome objections from clients who are frustrated, uncertain, or pushing back

Escalate serious concerns to management through the proper internal process

Keep accurate notes and records on every client interaction





Requirements

English — This Is Non-Negotiable

This role requires a level of English proficiency that is indistinguishable from a native speaker in both spoken and written form. Our clients are North American small business owners. Any accent, grammatical error, or awkward phrasing that makes a client feel they are speaking to someone overseas will damage the client relationship and reflect poorly on Swoop Lift.



You must speak English fluently and clearly with no accent that would be noticeable or distracting to a North American client. You will be on Zoom calls every single day with your camera on.

You must write in flawless English — correct grammar, correct spelling, correct punctuation, and natural phrasing — at a fast typing speed. All client communication is written and must be professional and error-free.

You must be able to produce all written communication yourself without the use of AI writing tools. We test for this during the hiring process and throughout employment. Use of AI to write client-facing messages is grounds for immediate termination.

You must be a fast typist. If your typing speed is below 50 words per minute, this role is not for you.



Other Requirements



You must be comfortable on camera. Every call is conducted on Zoom with your camera on. This is not optional.

You must have a reliable internet connection, a quiet working environment, and a clean professional background for video calls.

You must have strong emotional intelligence. Our clients are small business owners who are often stressed and reactive. You need to stay calm, composed, and empathetic when a client is difficult without taking it personally.

You must have excellent common sense and the ability to make decisions independently. We cannot micromanage every client interaction. You will need to read situations, use good judgment, and handle things on your own without being told what to do.

You must be organized and detail-oriented. You will be managing multiple client relationships simultaneously.

You must be a fast learner. We will train you on our services and processes but you are expected to retain information and apply it independently.

Candidates who need to be told what to do in every situation

About us

We are a North American digital marketing agency that works exclusively with lash extension businesses across the United States and Canada. We run paid advertising, lead generation, and end-to-end booking operations for approximately 50 lash studio owners. We cover our clients' ad spend, manage their leads, and book appointments on their behalf — all for a flat weekly fee.

We are a fast-growing, results-driven company that holds itself to a high standard. Every person on our team has a direct impact on client outcomes and company growth. We invest in our people and we pay well because we expect a lot.



About This Role

This is a full-time remote position that combines two functions: inbound discovery sales and client success management. You will be working directly with our founder and leadership team.

This is not a traditional sales role. You will not be cold calling or doing outbound prospecting. Prospective clients have already expressed interest in our services before speaking with you. Your job is to walk them through what we do, assess whether they are a good fit, and connect qualified prospects with our Lash Growth Specialist for the next step.

Alongside that, you will be managing relationships with our existing clients — answering their questions, reviewing their performance reports on Zoom, handling their concerns, and most importantly, overcoming objections from clients who are frustrated or uncertain. This part of the role requires emotional intelligence, composure, and the ability to stay calm and professional when a client is upset.

You must be a fast typist. If your typing speed is below 50 words per minute, this role is not for you.

You must be comfortable on camera. Every call is conducted on Zoom with your camera on. This is not optional.

You must have a reliable internet connection, a quiet working environment, and a clean professional background for video calls.

You must have strong emotional intelligence. Our clients are small business owners who are often stressed and reactive. You need to stay calm, composed, and empathetic when a client is difficult without taking it personally.

You must have excellent common sense and the ability to make decisions independently. We cannot micromanage every client interaction. You will need to read situations, use good judgment, and handle things on your own without being told what to do.

You must be organized and detail-oriented. You will be managing multiple client relationships simultaneously.

You must be a fast learner. We will train you on our services and processes but you are expected to retain information and apply it independently.

title: Billing Specialist | Accounts Receivable & Technical Project Billing
description:
About Coastal Communications



Coastal Communications is a growing U.S.-based telecommunications engineering and infrastructure services company. We support fiber-optic, wireless, utility, permitting, field engineering, design, inspection, and related technical projects.



We are seeking a dependable and detail-oriented Billing Specialist based in the Philippines to manage both straightforward administrative billing and more complex project-based billing. This position requires someone who can understand contracts, purchase orders, project records, employee time, billing rates, and supporting documentation—not simply create basic invoices.



Position Summary



The Billing Specialist will prepare accurate and timely invoices for Coastal Communications’ clients. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working with a mixture of:



Simple fixed-fee and recurring invoices

Hourly and time-and-material billing

Project milestone and percentage-completion billing

Unit-based or production billing

Purchase order and work order billing

Detailed telecommunications and engineering billing

Invoice backup packages and client-specific billing requirements



This role will work closely with company leadership, project managers, operations personnel, accounting staff, employees, and independent contractors to confirm that all completed work is properly documented and billed.



Key Responsibilities

Prepare, review, and submit client invoices accurately and on schedule.

Review contracts, proposals, purchase orders, statements of work, work authorizations, and client billing instructions.

Match employee and contractor time entries to approved billing rates, projects, tasks, and purchase orders.

Prepare billing for hourly, fixed-fee, milestone, unit-based, recurring, and time-and-material projects.

Verify that invoices include all required supporting documentation.

Create organized invoice packages containing timesheets, production reports, field records, deliverables, receipts, and other required backup.

Track project budgets, authorized amounts, billing limits, purchase order balances, and previously invoiced amounts.

Identify unbilled work, missing time, incomplete records, billing discrepancies, and potential revenue leakage.

Communicate with project managers and staff to resolve missing or inaccurate billing information.

Maintain billing schedules and ensure invoices are submitted before client deadlines.

Enter invoices and related information into QuickBooks or other accounting and project-management systems.

Monitor accounts receivable and prepare reports showing invoice status, payment status, aging, and outstanding balances.

Follow up professionally regarding overdue invoices, rejected invoices, or requests for revised documentation.

Maintain accurate electronic billing files and client records.

Assist with account reconciliation, collections support, reporting, and month-end billing close.

Recommend improvements to billing procedures, internal controls, and documentation processes.

Protect confidential company, client, employee, and financial information.

Required Qualifications

At least three years of billing, invoicing, accounts receivable, bookkeeping, or accounting-support experience.

Strong experience preparing invoices from contracts, purchase orders, timesheets, rate sheets, and project records.

Comfortable managing both simple invoices and detailed technical or project-based billing.

Advanced attention to detail and accuracy.

Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills.

Experience with QuickBooks Online or similar accounting software.

Ability to understand billing rates, quantities, units, project codes, task codes, and budget limits.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Ability to communicate professionally with U.S.-based managers, employees, vendors, and clients.

Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.

Ability to manage multiple billing deadlines without constant supervision.

Reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and a professional remote working environment.

Willingness to maintain reasonable working-hour overlap with the U.S. Pacific Time Zone.

Preferred Qualifications



Experience in one or more of the following industries is strongly preferred:



Telecommunications

Fiber-optic engineering or construction

Utility or infrastructure services

Architecture or engineering

Construction

Professional services

Field services

Government contracting

Project-based consulting



Additional preferred experience includes:



QuickBooks Online

Accounts-receivable aging and collections

Purchase order reconciliation

Progress or milestone billing

Time-and-material billing

Contractor and employee timesheet review

Client billing portals

Month-end closing procedures

Project-management or timekeeping platforms

Technical Billing Expectations



Applicants do not need to be telecommunications engineers. However, the selected candidate must be willing and able to learn terminology associated with projects such as:



Fiber design and field engineering

Permitting and right-of-way services

GIS and CAD drafting

Utility coordination

Pole surveys and inspections

Traffic-control plans

Small-cell and wireless projects

Construction inspection

As-built documentation

Project deliverables and production units



The Billing Specialist must be able to connect completed technical work to the correct project, purchase order, contract rate, billing unit, and invoice documentation.



What Success Looks Like



A successful Billing Specialist will:



Submit accurate invoices by every required deadline.

Reduce missed or delayed billing.

Identify completed work that has not yet been invoiced.

Maintain accurate purchase order and project-balance records.

Provide complete supporting documentation with each invoice.

Resolve billing discrepancies promptly.

Keep leadership informed of unbilled revenue, overdue invoices, and potential billing issues.

Create organized systems that make billing easier to review and audit.

Work Schedule



This is a full-time remote position based in the Philippines.



The employee must be available for scheduled meetings and regular communication with Coastal Communications’ U.S.-based team. Some overlap with Pacific Time business hours will be required. The final schedule may include a combination of Philippine daytime work and designated U.S. business-hour coverage.



Compensation



Competitive monthly compensation based on experience, technical billing knowledge, accounting skills, English proficiency, and availability.



Applicants should include their expected monthly compensation in Philippine pesos.



How to Apply



Please submit:



Your updated résumé.

A brief introduction describing your billing and accounts-receivable experience.

The accounting, billing, and project-management software you have used.

An example of the most complex billing process you have managed.

Your experience reviewing contracts, purchase orders, timesheets, or rate sheets.

Your expected monthly compensation in Philippine pesos.

Your availability to begin.

Your preferred working hours and ability to overlap with U.S. Pacific Time.

The word “Coastal” at the beginning of your application subject line.



Applications that do not address the questions above may not be considered.

We are looking for a reliable B2B Outbound Caller / Lead Qualification Specialist to join our team. This is a remote, part-time position based in the Philippines, starting at 20 hours/week, with the potential to increase hours based on performance.

Your main responsibility is to call sign shops and printing shops in North America, identify the right contact person, collect accurate information, and confirm whether they are interested in receiving a NOVA trade sample kit. 3+ years of experience in outbound calling, appointment setting, telemarketing, lead generation, or B2B prospecting.

Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral, and professional accent.

title: Systems Coordinator / Virtual Assistant (Cleaning Company – Alaska Time)
description:
JOB TITLE: Systems Accuracy Coordinator



COMPANY: Juneau Cleaning



POSITION TYPE:

Remote (Virtual Assistant)

Part-Time

10-20 Hours Per Week



COMPENSATION:

Starting compensation based on experience and demonstrated ability.



This role begins as a focused backend support position with opportunities for increased hours, responsibilities, and compensation as trust and competency are demonstrated.



ABOUT JUNEAU CLEANING



Juneau Cleaning is a fast-growing residential and commercial cleaning company based in Alaska. We are building systems that allow our company to scale while maintaining exceptional service and operational excellence.



We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys organization, accuracy, systems, and problem-solving.



This is not a customer service role.



This is not a scheduling role.



This is not a sales role.



This is a backend operations role focused on ensuring company information is accurate, complete, organized, and reliable.



POSITION OVERVIEW



The Systems Accuracy Coordinator supports the Admin Assistant and Owner by identifying mistakes, inconsistencies, and missing information before they become problems.



Your job is to make sure our systems are correct.



You will review timesheets, invoices, quotes, job details, and operational records to ensure everything is accurate before it impacts customers, employees, payroll, or company operations.



If you naturally catch mistakes, enjoy checklists, and believe details matter, this role may be an excellent fit.



MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS



Recent, hands-on Jobber experience is required.



Candidates without substantial Jobber experience will not be considered.



You should be comfortable navigating Jobber and performing tasks such as:



• Reviewing jobs and visits

• Reviewing quotes and invoices

• Auditing job details

• Reviewing timesheets

• Verifying customer information

• Reviewing notes and attachments

• Identifying inconsistencies within the platform



Additional Requirements:



• Strong written English

• Exceptional attention to detail

• Reliable internet connection

• Strong organizational skills

• Ability to work independently

• Ability to follow established systems and procedures

• Comfortable learning new software and workflows



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



1. TIMESHEET VERIFICATION



• Review employee timesheets for accuracy

• Verify clock-in and clock-out records

• Identify discrepancies and missing information

• Flag issues before payroll review



2. INVOICING



• Prepare and process customer invoices

• Verify invoice accuracy before sending

• Ensure completed work aligns with invoiced services



3. QUOTING



• Prepare customer quotes using company systems

• Verify quote accuracy and completeness

• Follow established pricing guidelines



4. JOB READINESS REVIEW



Review upcoming jobs to ensure they are fully prepared, including:



• Accurate job notes

• Access information

• Attachments and checklists

• Before photos when applicable

• Correct service duration

• Proper crew assignments

• Complete customer information



Identify missing information before jobs occur.



SYSTEMS MANAGEMENT



• Maintain accurate records in Jobber and company systems

• Ensure operational information remains organized

• Support system accuracy and consistency



PROCESS IMPROVEMENT



• Document recurring processes

• Maintain SOPs and internal documentation

• Identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement

• Support operational excellence through consistent systems



RESPONSIBILITIES EXCLUDED FROM THIS ROLE



• Customer communication

• Employee communication

• Scheduling

• Sales

• Hiring or termination decisions

• Employee management

• Marketing and advertising

• Final payroll approval



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



• Errors are caught before they affect customers or employees

• Jobs are fully prepared before cleaners arrive

• Timesheets, invoices, and quotes are accurate

• Company systems remain organized and reliable

• The Admin Assistant and Owner spend less time correcting mistakes

• Problems are identified before they become emergencies



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Describe a specific situation where you used Jobber to identify, prevent, or resolve an operational error.



Please include:



1. The exact problem

2. How you discovered it

3. Which areas of Jobber you reviewed

4. The actions you took

5. The final outcome

6. One improvement that could prevent the issue in the future



Use your answer to the following question as the subject line:



What is usually missing when things go wrong?



Keep your answer to 1-3 words.



Applications that do not follow instructions or do not demonstrate Jobber experience will not be considered.



SKILL REQUIREMENTS

• Jobber

• Attention to Detail

• English Proficiency

• Problem Solving

• Process Documentation

title: Shopee Operations
description:
We're looking for a hands-on Shopee operations expert to own and scale our marketplace presence across multiple countries. This is a role for someone who knows Shopee inside and out — not just uploading products, but managing the full operational cycle and solving the platform's trickier logistics and SKU challenges.



What you'll do



• Open and manage Shopee shops across multiple countries, owning the full cycle: listings, visibility, inventory, and promotions.



• Manage SKU structure and inventory syncing across markets, ensuring accuracy and consistency.

Navigate Shopee's logistics flows — including Korean logistics (SLS), separation, and overseas shipping — and help drive a smooth SLS-to-FBS transition.



• Analyze country-level performance data (sales, ad performance, CTR, conversion rate, inventory turnover) to diagnose root causes and recommend fixes.



 What we're looking for



• Multi-country Shopee experience (must-have): You've personally opened and run Shopee shops in more than one country and managed the full operational cycle end to end.



• Strong SKU & logistics knowledge (must-verify): You deeply understand SKU management, inventory syncing, and country-specific shipping and inbound processes. Given Shopee's known logistics bottlenecks — particularly around SKU structure and the current SLS-to-FBS transition — proven logistics expertise is essential.



• Data-driven problem-solving: You can look at country-level sales, ad metrics, CTR, conversion rates, and inventory turnover and pinpoint whether weak performance stems from product, pricing, ads, or logistics/inventory — then act on it.



Why this matters



Shopee operations live or die by logistics and SKU discipline. We need someone who can untangle bottlenecks, keep inventory flowing across borders, and turn data into decisions.



How to Apply:



If you think you're a great fit, send me your updated resume via a Google Drive link. Please make sure the link is set so anyone with the link can view and download it, so we can access it without delay.



Fit applicants will be shortlisted. Please note that candidates without relevant Shopee operations experience will not be entertained.

Please submit your resume (with active
 address included), portfolio, and a brief cover letter explaining why you would be a great fit for this Senior Video Editor role.

description:

Zibol is changing the way recruitment agencies operate in Australia. We provide fully managed, recruitment trained virtual assistant resources that save our clients 40+ hours a week, freeing founders to grow and scale their businesses.



Our VAs are not generic admin support. They are trained recruiters who plug straight into our clients' delivery processes, and they are central to everything we do. We manage the VA's on behalf of our clients.



We are launching in July 2026 and you would be joining throughout our launch period, helping up set up the Philippines operations, and then recruiting, managing and training the VA's we onboard.



The Role

- You will own our offshore VA workforce end to end. 

- That means finding and hiring recruitment-experienced VAs, training them to our standard, and leading the team day to day.

- You will report directly to our Australian-based directors and work closely with our founders to keep the offshore team performing at the level our clients expect.

- As part of the role, you will also train the VAs on end-to-end recruitment processes within our bootcamp, then run monthly webinars to upskill the team and monitor their performance against KPI's.

- Hiring VA's: advertising roles, sourcing, screening, video interviews, reference checking, compliance, and onboarding.

- Training: running 5 day training bootcamps, masterclasses, and weekly check-ins - building every VA's capability against our delivery processes.

- Leadership: managing the team, handling their inquiries, tracking performance and KPIs, and reporting capability and risks back to the directors.



What You Must Have

- 5+ years of end-to-end recruitment experience in an agency environment 

- Proven experience managing offshore recruiters in the Philippines

- Confidence running group training sessions and 1:1 coaching

- Confidence with team leadership, KPIs, and reporting

- A self-starter mindset, someone who works independently, is comfortable building from the early stage, and can both execute the work and bring strategic ideas to the founders



Why This Role Is Different

- You are not stepping into someone else's system. You are building it with us. As this is the first role we are hiring, there's a huge opportunity to grow a large team of recruiters around you and work towards a Management role within the first year.

 

- You will lead an offshore recruitment function from day one, with direct access to the founders who will mentor you and real ownership of how it grows. As Zibol scales, you scale with it.



Who This Role Is Not For

- If you are someone who needs clear step-by-step instructions to execute, this role is not for you. The Founders can guide you, but you need to have a strategic mindset and to be able to think outside the box to make suggestions and help the business succeed.

- Direct access to 2 Founders who will mentor you - with over 30 years experience collectively

- Opportunity to grow into a management role within 12 months

title: Influencer / Outreach Manager
description:
We are a fast-growing e-commerce company in the health and wellness space, managing multiple successful online brands.

We are looking for a driven Influencer / Outreach Manager to grow our creator network, manage partnerships, and execute influencer campaigns that increase brand visibility and drive measurable results.



Key Responsibilities

Identify, evaluate, and onboard influencers and creators across TikTok, Instagram, and other key platforms

Develop and execute influencer outreach and partnership strategies aligned with brand goals

Manage end-to-end influencer campaigns (briefing, negotiation, content delivery, tracking, reporting)

Build and maintain strong relationships with creators, agencies, and partners

Track deliverables, contracts, timelines, and campaign performance with accuracy and accountability

Collaborate with internal teams to ensure campaigns align with marketing and brand objectives

Monitor social media trends and competitor activity to identify new partnership opportunities

Maintain influencer database/CRM and ensure data accuracy for reporting and scaling strategies



Creator Marketing & Operations (SOP Ownership)

End-to-end Creator Ops Pipeline

Scraping & Vetting of Influencers

Profile Approvals

Outreach Management

Logging Rates & Negotiation Tracking

Script / Flow Writing for Outreach

Content Management & Tracking





Must have skills:

2+ years experience in influencer marketing, TikTok operations, or social media partnerships

Proven experience managing influencer campaigns from outreach to execution

Strong attention to detail in tracking deliverables, contracts, and timelines

Excellent communication and negotiation skills

Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and reliability

Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

Familiarity with social media platforms (TikTok, Instagram, etc.) and creator ecosystems

Experience using spreadsheets, CRM tools, or influencer tracking systems

Strong analytical thinking with the ability to identify challenges quickly and implement effective solutions.

Self-motivated and disciplined, with the ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and stay accountable in a remote setup.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, PR, or related field (preferred but not required)

Proven portfolio of successful influencer campaigns or partnerships



Schedule

Full 8-hour graveyard shift required

Must be fully available for US hours

Proven experience managing influencer campaigns from outreach to execution

Strong attention to detail in tracking deliverables, contracts, and timelines

Excellent communication and negotiation skills

Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and reliability

Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

Familiarity with social media platforms (TikTok, Instagram, etc.) and creator ecosystems

Experience using spreadsheets, CRM tools, or influencer tracking systems



What We Offer

Fully remote full-time role

Training and onboarding support

Growth opportunity into a higher leadership role

Exposure to multiple fast-scaling e-commerce brands



How to Apply

Please submit a complete application that includes your resume and a thoughtful, original cover letter. In your cover letter, naturally incorporate the phrase “I love coffee” and share something about yourself that isn’t reflected in your resume. Also answer the following screening questions.



1. How many years of experience do you have in influencer marketing or outreach? Please describe your key responsibilities.

All applications will be carefully reviewed to assess alignment with the role’s requirements. Shortlisted will receive an

title: Long-Term YouTube & Short Form Content Producer for Western Brand
description:

We are building a media company around craftsmanship, rodeo, and storytelling.



If you're looking for short freelance projects, this position probably isn't for you.



If you enjoy turning raw footage into stories that people actually want to watch, keep reading.



About Us



Slingin Shanks is a handmade western brand based in North Carolina.



Our products are trusted by world champion rodeo athletes, working cowboys, and competitors across multiple rodeo events.



Our goal isn't simply to sell spurs.



We're building a brand that people remember.

Shop footage

Customer stories

Athlete footage

Suggestions for thumbnail text

Organized project files

I'm looking for someone who can recognize a story.

You don't need to know rodeo.



You DO need to understand YouTube.

MrBeast

Peter McKinnon

Ali Abdaal

Colin and Samir

Johnny Harris

Think Media

But because I want someone who studies why people continue watching videos.

Storytelling

Pacing

Curiosity

Hooks

Emotional 
nts

CapCut

Premiere Pro

DaVinci Resolve

Final Cut



Hours



Starting:



15-20 hours per week



Opportunity to grow into a full-time role.



Pay



Based on experience.



Raises will be based on contribution and long-term performance—not just time worked.



To Apply



Please answer ALL of these questions.



1.



What YouTube channel do you believe has the best editing?



Why?



2.



Show me ONE YouTube video that represents your absolute best work.

If you were given one hour of raw footage, how would you d

5.

6.

at the beginning of your application so I know you read this entire posting.



Applications that don't include those words will not be considered.

I value creativity, communication, and consistency more than flashy editing.



I would rather publish one great story than ten average videos.



If you enjoy finding stories that other people overlook, we'd probably work well together.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Customer Support Specialist

(Remote — Philippines-based)

Hours: 6:30am – 3:00pm AEST (daylight savings may apply)

About MachShip

MachShip is a fast-growing, cloud-based freight management platform that simplifies logistics for businesses across Australia. We connect shippers with carriers, streamline freight workflows, and help our customers take the complexity out of moving goods. Our team is collaborative, curious, and genuinely invested in the customer experience — and we're looking for someone who shares that energy.



About the Role

As a Customer Support Specialist, you'll be the first point of contact for MachShip customers — responding to enquiries, diagnosing issues, and delivering fast, accurate, and empathetic support across our channels. This is a hands-on role where you'll develop deep platform knowledge, contribute to our knowledge base, and work closely with a high-performing support team.



You'll thrive here if you take genuine ownership of your work, communicate clearly under pressure, and approach every problem with curiosity and method. We use AI tools to work smarter, but your understanding always comes first.



What You'll Be Doing

• Responding to customer enquiries across
 and support channels in a timely, professional manner

• Accurately diagnosing and resolving common issues using documented processes, product knowledge, and available tools

• Escalating complex issues to Senior Specialists or Team Leaders with clear, detailed case notes — never passing on a ticket without full context

• Managing your personal ticket queue to SLA requirements, owning each ticket from open to resolution

• Building and maintaining product knowledge through onboarding, training, and self-directed learning

• Contributing to knowledge base articles by flagging gaps and suggesting improvements based on what you observe

• Documenting cases accurately and thoroughly in the ticketing system

• Using AI tools to draft, research, and improve quality — while always verifying content before it reaches a customer

• Participating in tea
etings, stand-ups, and quality review processes



What We're Looking For

Essential

• 2+ years of experience in a customer-facing support or technical support role

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — clear, professional, and empathetic

• Proactive by nature — you identify what needs doing and act on it without being asked

• Exceptional problem-solving skills — methodical, logical, and accurate under pressure

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy in all written communications and case notes

• Ability to manage a busy ticket queue and prioritise effectively

• Comfortable learning and working across new software platforms (Zoho Desk, Zendesk, Jira or similar)

• Calm and composed when handling challenging or frustrated customer interactions

• Honest about knowledge limits — you know when to escalate, and you do it well



Desirable

• Experience in a SaaS or technology environment

• Exposure to logistics, freight, or supply chain platforms (e.g. Sendle, Transvirtual, Toll, Shipit)

• Familiarity with SLA-based ticketing systems and CRM platforms

• Tertiary qualification in IT, Business, Communications, or a related field



The Person We're Looking For

You communicate exceptionally well — whether it's a technical explanation, a difficult update to a frustrated customer, or a well-written case note that someone else can pick up instantly. You take initiative without waiting to be directed, and when something doesn't go to plan, your first instinct is to understand why and fix it properly.



You're curious about how things work and motivated to grow your technical knowledge over time. You understand that accuracy matters — and that a well-escalated ticket is always better than a rushed resolution. You're a team player who contributes beyond your own queue.



Hours: 6:30am – 3:00pm AEST, aligned with Australian business hours. Daylight savings may apply.

Please note: Skills testing will form part of the recruitment process for this role.



Our Values

• Delight Our Customers — everything we do shapes their experience

• Sweat the Small Stuff — progress comes from doing the details well

• One Team — we're all on the same side, solving shared problems

• Challenge With Curiosity — better outcomes come from good questions and respectful debate

• Go Hard or Go Home — we offer flexibility and trust, and expect energy, integrity, and ownership in return



How to Apply

title: Appointment Setter for U.S. Life Insurance Agency — Base + Bonus Per Appt ($600-$2,000/mo potential) — LONG TERM
description:
Hi future rockstar 

I run a life insurance agency in Florida (Globe Life — American Income Division) and I'm looking to build a small, tight team of 2–3 top-tier appointment setters in the Philippines to call warm leads in the U.S.



This is NOT a cold-calling boiler room. These are warm leads — real Americans who filled out a form online asking about life insurance for their family. Your job is simple: call them back, confirm they're interested, and book them onto my calendar. I do the closing.



If you're fast, coachable, have clear English, and you actually want to build a career instead of bouncing between gigs — read on.



WHAT YOU'LL EARN



Base: $3–$6/hr depending on experience (paid weekly via Wise / PayPal)

Bonus: Paid per appointment that shows up to the call with me

Closer bonus: Additional bonus if the appointment turns into a closed sale

Top performer bonus: Weekly + monthly

Realistic monthly earnings: $600–$1,200/mo starting. Top performers hit $1,500–$2,500/mo consistently.

13th month + paid time off after 6 months

Annual raise based on performance



This is a long-term role. I'm not looking for someone for 2 months. I want to train you, pay you well, and grow with you for years.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



Call warm U.S. leads using our power dialer (auto-dials for you — no manual dialing)

Follow our proven script (7 steps, I'll train you on it day 1)

Confirm interest, light qualifying, book them onto my Google Calendar

Send SMS confirmations + reminders (we have templates)

Log every call in the CRM with a disposition code

Submit end-of-day report on Slack

Attend daily 10-min huddle + weekly 1-on-1 coaching



~50–80 dials per hour. 3–8 appointments per shift is the target.



 MUST HAVE



Very clear spoken English — Americans must understand you easily. Neutral/light accent preferred.

Minimum 1 year BPO, appointment setting, or sales call experience

Stable fiber internet — 25+ Mbps (NO mobile hotspots, NO unstable connections)

Noise-cancelling USB headset (not a gaming one, not laptop mic)

Backup power (UPS) — brownouts cannot stop your shift

Quiet dedicated workspace — no roosters, no karaoke neighbor, no kids running around during calls

Willing to work U.S. hours — most shifts run 2 PM – 11 AM Manila time (this is U.S. daytime)

Laptop/desktop less than 3 years old

Tech-savvy enough to learn a CRM, Google Calendar, Calendly and 
 in 2–3 days





 NICE TO HAVE (not required, but moves you to the top of the pile)



Previous experience selling insurance, final expense, or mortgage leads to U.S. customers

Experience with Go High Level, Wavv, or similar dialers

Coachable, humble, and hungry — willing to be QA'd daily for the first 2 weeks





 PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF



Your English is not crystal clear on the phone

You're looking for a "part-time side thing" — I need commitment

You can't work U.S. hours (I pay a night differential — it's worth it)

You've never done phone work before

You get nervous on calls or freeze under pressure

You see this as a stepping stone — I want long-term teammates





 HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY — this is how I filter)

Applications that don't follow these steps will be ignored. This isn't me being difficult — it's me filtering for people who actually read instructions. That skill matters in this job.

Put this exact phrase in your cover letter subject line:



I READ THE POST — ABIN SAJI 2026



In your application, send me:



A 60-second voice recording (Vocaroo link works great) reading this out loud in your most natural "phone voice":





"Hey John, this is Sam calling from Globe Life, American Income Division. You recently requested some information on life insurance coverage for your family — does that ring a bell? Awesome — I'm not the agent, I'm just the one who gets you scheduled with our licensed underwriter in your state. It'll only take me 2–3 minutes to confirm a few things and get you on the calendar. Fair enough?"





A short paragraph (3–5 sentences) answering: What's the biggest objection you've ever overcome on a call, and how?

A screenshot of your internet speed test (speedtest.net)

Your expected monthly rate (base only, not including bonus)

Your available start date





 HIRING PROCESS



Week 1: I review applications and invite the top 10 to a Zoom interview

Week 2: Top 3 do a paid 2-hour role-play / mock call session

Week 3: Top 1–2 start paid training

Month 2: If you hit minimum KPIs ? you're on the team for the long haul





 WHY WORK WITH ME

I'm not a faceless agency. I'm a working agent who built this team to scale my own book. That means:



You talk directly to the owner (me), not 3 layers of managers

Feedback loops are fast — I can change scripts, fix tools, raise pay instantly

I actually reward performance — top producers make real money here

I invest in training. You'll leave this job a better setter than you came in, guaranteed.

I'm looking for 2–3 people. If that's you — apply today. I review every application personally.



Salam / Kumusta,

Abin Saji

Globe Life — American Income Division

Orlando, FL, US

The work will include creating AI images, generating AI video clips, building character and scene consistency, testing different prompts, improving outputs from feedback, selecting the best clips, editing, captions, sound or music placement where needed, and preparing final 9:16 files.



You should understand that vertical micro-dramas are not just attractive AI visuals. They need clear story hooks, emotional beats, character consistency, readable framing on a phone screen, and clips that can be edited into a coherent sequence.



Required:



Strong generative AI image and video creation skills

Hands-on Seedance 2.0 experience

Good visual taste

Ability to work in 9:16 vertical format

Ability to create story-led scenes with hooks, reactions, conflict, reveals, and payoff 
nts

Ability to prompt for character consistency, wardrobe, camera movement, mood, lighting, location, and scene detail

Ability to notice weak composition, poor motion, flicker, artifacts, bad anatomy, and generic AI-looking output

Ability to explain your workflow clearly

Ability to take feedback and improve the work quickly



Nice to have:



Experience with Midjourney, Runway, Kling, Luma, Pika, Veo, Sora, Flux, Stable Diffusion, or ComfyUI

Experience with Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, Photoshop, or Canva

Experience with AI audio or voice tools such as ElevenLabs

Basic editing, captions, sound, grading, and delivery formatting



Please apply with:



1. A short note about your experience with Seedance 2.0

3. Examples of AI-generated images

5. Any 9:16 vertical narrative or micro-drama work

6. Notes showing your prompt or workflow process, if available

I’m not looking for someone to run the creative strategy. I will provide creative direction, story direction, and quality standards. I’m looking for someone who can execute, iterate, improve, and help turn ideas into strong visual assets.



This is intended to be a long-term working relationship for the right person.

title: Paid Social Creative Strategist & Media Buyer (Agency)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are an elite, high-growth marketing agency specializing in local multi-location customer acquisition for highly sensitive, high-trust niches—specifically Childcare, Early Childhood Education, and ABA (Applied Behavior Analysis) Therapy. We do not build "pretty grids"; we build aggressive, high-converting direct-response machines that fill local centers with eager families.



We are searching for a master direct-response (DR) marketer who understands the Science of Vetting great marketing hooks and translating them into high-converting assets. Your mission is to take aggressive, high-performance direct-response frameworks typically weaponized in hyper-competitive spaces (like B2B or fintech) and beautifully adapt them into warm, high-trust, high-conversion localized ads that compel parents to enroll their children.



If you understand consumer psychology, know how to reverse-engineer winning ad frameworks, and can maintain a New York standard of excellence under tight agency deadlines, this role is for you.



YOUR CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Competitor Reverse-Engineering & Creative Strategy

Mine the
 Ad Library across multiple industries to identify high-performing layouts, visual styles, and psychological hooks.

Deconstruct winning direct-response frameworks from outside industries and ethically adapt those angles for childcare and ABA therapy brands.

2. Direct-Response Angle & Copywriting

Write high-converting, emotionally resonant ad copy engineered specifically for modern parents, speaking directly to high-stakes pain points: safety anxieties, developmental milestones, behavioral challenges, and navigating state subsidies or insurance.

Develop clear, compelling variations of primary text, headlines, and description combinations to systematically test in Meta.

3. Visual Direction & Asset Production

Design or heavily storyboard high-contrast, attention-grabbing static ads and short-form video concepts (Reels/TikTok style).

Ensure all creative assets are built to stop the scroll even with the sound turned completely off through aggressive use of captions, visual cues, and hook placement.

4. Meta Campaign Management & Optimization

Launch, monitor, and scale local lead-generation campaigns inside Meta Ads Manager.

Analyze creative performance metrics (Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR, CPA) to decisively cycle out underperforming assets and double down on agency winners.



REQUIREMENTS



1.Proven Track Record: At least 2-3 years of verifiable experience managing Meta 
/Instagram) ad campaigns with a      heavy focus on lead generation or local multi-location services.

2.The DR Mindset: Deep understanding of direct-response marketing principles. You design for cash flow and conversions, not "brand awareness" or vanity metrics.

3. Design Literacy: Mastery of Canva (or advanced design tools like Photoshop/Figma) to quickly iterate high-converting static variations and clear video storyboards.

4. Psychological Acumen: The ability to understand the deep, emotional, and often stressful buying journey of a parent choosing childcare or developmental therapy.

5. Schedule: Full-time (40 hours per week). Flexible daily schedule, but must have guaranteed overlap with US business hours for team syncs and client alignment.



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



Rate: $8.00 – $10.00 per hour (up to $12.00 per hour for absolute rockstars with elite portfolios).

Hours: Consistent, long-term 40 hours per week.

Reliable, Fast Payouts: Prompt and seamless weekly payments processed securely via Wise.

Agency Growth: Work with a leading agency with massive long-term career growth opportunities and internal promotion pathways.



HOW TO APPLY 



?? STRICT ANTI-SPAM WARNING: Any generic, automated, or copy-pasted templates that fail to follow these exact instructions or miss the analysis question below will be immediately deleted without review. We only hire the top 1%.

To apply for this elite position, send an
/message with the exact subject line format: [Creative Strategist - Your Name].

Find a live, high-impression direct-response ad from a hyper-competitive, non-childcare industry (e.g., AG1, Hims/Hers, a major SaaS brand, or a medical clinic). Provide the concept description or URL, and write a 3–4 sentence psychological breakdown explaining exactly why that specific ad format works to capture attention and drive action.

title: Accounts & Payroll Officer

Records & Admin - File keeping (digital + physical): naming conventions, retention, and audit trail integrity. - Data entry and record maintenance; asset & inventory register upkeep. - Light office admin: office maintenance coordination, stationery ordering, supplier onboarding and contact management.

·      3–5 years bookkeeping, AR/AP, and payroll (including Superannuation) experience in an SME.

description:
AJG Transport is expanding its route operations division and seeking a reliable, detail-oriented professional to help support and streamline our daily transportation duties, with a primary focus on Memphis lanes. Role Overview

As an Transportation Tracker, you will serve as a real time control point within route operations. Your responsibility is to ensure loads are properly assigned, tracked, updated, and documented while maintaining consistent communication across drivers, brokers, and customers. You will operate within structured SOPs while making fast, sound operational decisions when challenges arise.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor live fleet movement using GPS and TMS

• Track and update ETAs, check calls, timestamps, and delivery milestones in real time

• Enter, audit, and maintain accurate load data in Google Sheets and TMS

• Communicate continuously with drivers, brokers, and customers regarding status updates

• Identify delays, route conflicts, detention risks, or service issues and take proactive action

• Escalate operational risks to leadership when necessary

• Generate shift-based operational reports summarizing load activity, Memphis lane updates, and exceptions

• Follow dispatch, communication, and escalation SOPs consistently

• Maintain clean shift handoffs and organized documentation



What Success Looks Like

• Memphis lanes are monitored closely and executed with urgency, accuracy, and consistency

• TMS, Google Sheets, and tracking platforms reflect complete and error-free data at all times

• Scheduled updates are sent on time

• Critical loads are monitored closely and handled with urgency from start to finish

• Communication is clear, concise, and actionable, both in written updates and verbal escalations

• Operational risks and issues are flagged early with solutions, not just problems

• Shift handoffs are smooth, complete, and well documented

• You become someone the team can depend on during high-pressure situations



Who We’re Looking For

• Has experience in logistics, freight brokerage, dispatch, or transportation tracking

• Understanding of fleet coordination, load planning, and HOS awareness

• Familiar with US geography and US logistics trucking operations (a plus)

• Ability to monitor multiple loads and drivers simultaneously

• Understands urgency and prioritization in a live dispatch environment

• Communicates clearly and professionally via zoom, chat, and email

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Can monitor multiple loads at once without losing accuracy

• Pays strong attention to detail and uses sound judgment when issues arise

• Comfortable operating in high volume communication environments

• Follows instructions consistently and values clean execution

• Works well with a team and is open to feedback and coaching. Collaborates without resistance or ego



Why Join AJG Transport?

• Permanent remote opportunity

• Structured systems and clear expectations

• Hands on leadership and direct feedback

• Defined KPIs and measurable growth

• Opportunity to grow within a scaling freight brokerage

• Performance recognition and advancement potential

Work Speed

PETBRAND at the top

 and portal messaging.

title: Business Development Representative (BDR) — Commercial Refrigeration Services
description:
About Us



Master Seal Craft is a local, independent company serving restaurants, grocery stores, and convenience stores across Sacramento, Reno, and Lake Tahoe. We specialize in commercial refrigeration door seals, gaskets, and hardware — keeping kitchens inspection-ready and compliant, 365 days a year.

Our flagship offering is the Seal Integrity Program: scheduled 90-day inspections where we catch worn gaskets and broken hardware before they become health code violations or emergency repair calls. No franchises. No call centers. Just skilled local technicians who show up on time and do the job right.





About the Role

We're looking for a confident, personable cold caller to reach out to restaurant managers, grocery store owners, and convenience store operators from a lead database we provide. Your job is to get the decision-maker on the phone, briefly explain what we do, and book a free first visit where we inspect their equipment and replace the first gasket at no charge.





What You'll Do

• Call a provided list of restaurants, grocery stores, and convenience stores in the Sacramento / Reno / Lake Tahoe area.

• Navigate to the owner, general manager, or kitchen manager.

• Deliver a short, natural pitch about our free first inspection and gasket replacement offer.

• Overcome common objections (e.g., "we already have a guy," "we do it ourselves," "not interested right now").

• Book the appointment and log the outcome in our CRM.

• Track your daily call volume and conversion metrics.







What We're Looking For

• Proven cold calling or telemarketing experience — you're comfortable with rejection and know how to turn a "no" into a conversation.

• Excellent spoken English — clear, natural, and confident on the phone with American business owners and managers.

• Resilience & persistence — you don't get discouraged after a few hang-ups.

• Quick thinking — you can handle objections without sounding scripted.

• Reliable setup — a stable internet connection and a quiet workspace for making calls (we'll provide the dialer/softphone).

• US business experience — calling US-based businesses is a strong plus.

• Industry familiarity — experience with the food service or restaurant industry is a bonus but not required.





Why Join Us

• Tangible value — you're not selling something vague; you're offering a free, no-strings first visit with a clear benefit (compliance, avoiding health inspector fines, free gasket).

• Simple pitch — straightforward offering with no complex product catalog to memorize.

• Long-term opportunity — we're building a repeatable outbound engine, not a one-off campaign.

Remote freedom — work remotely with a small, straightforward team and no corporate layers.



To help us get to know you better, please fill out this brief Google Form in addition to submitting your resume and application.

title: Finance Deal / Engagement Manager
description:
Remote · Full-time



About us: Artane Partners helps companies raise money from investors. A company hires us when they need funding, and we connect them to investors (mostly large investors in the Gulf region) and guide the whole process until they get the investment.



The role



When a company hires us, there's a full process to get them their funding: preparing documents, getting them in front of the right investors, and guiding the deal until an investment is agreed. You're the person who keeps that whole process organized and moving for each company we work with, so nothing gets stuck and deals actually get done.



You don't need to have done this exact job before. If you're extremely organized, good with people, and the kind of person who chases things until they're finished, we'll teach you the rest.



What you'll do



- Look after each company we're helping, from the day they hire us until they get their investment

- Always know where each deal stands and what needs to happen next - you'll keep a clear, up-to-date list of all of them

- Make sure the documents get made. We create things like a short "teaser" and a longer "investment memo" (documents that present the company to investors) and a financial spreadsheet showing the numbers. Our analysts build these - your job is to make sure they're done on time and done well

- Get the company in front of investors. You'll work with our investor team to make sure each company is shown to the right investors, and that investor questions get answered

- Stay in touch with the company (our client). Keep them updated, answer their questions, and make sure they send us what we need on time

- Chase everything. Follow up with the team, the client, and the investors so nothing gets forgotten or stuck. This is most of the job - keeping things moving

- Handle the paperwork. Make sure agreements (like confidentiality agreements and contracts) get sent and signed

- Keep pushing until the deal is done - until an investment is agreed and the money comes in. That's the goal you're working toward on every deal



What we're looking for



- Incredibly organized - you like lists, tracking, and keeping things in order, and you never lose track of what's outstanding

- A great communicator - comfortable
ing and speaking with clients and the team in a professional way

- A finisher - you chase things until they're done and don't let them slip

- Reliable and proactive - you take initiative instead of waiting to be told

title: Guest Experience Specialist (Remote Host)
description:
Guest Experience Specialist (Remote Host)

About Casa Oso

Casa Oso is a small collection of beautiful, well-hosted homes in the Sierra, near Yosemite — peaceful places in nature where genuine hosting, supported by thoughtful design, helps guests relax, connect, and enjoy time together.



The difference between renting a place and being a guest comes down to preparation, attention to detail, and care — every interaction shapes a stay that feels welcoming, easy, and thoughtfully prepared.



Every guest should feel genuinely cared for from the first message to checkout, and we're looking for a Guest Experience Specialist to be the voice behind it. This is a fully remote contractor role, with 8-hour shifts within our 8:00 AM–11:00 PM Pacific (California) coverage window.



You're proactive, reliable, and enjoy helping people — calm under pressure and quick to solve problems before they grow. You're thoughtful and detail-oriented, and you know small actions behind the scenes make a guest's stay feel effortless.



Key Responsibilities:

Help guests feel informed, supported, and cared for through messaging and voice communication.

Assist guests with reservations, cancellations, concierge requests, and other stay-related inquiries.

Coordinate with our local cleaners, handymen, and service providers so homes are ready and guest needs are handled promptly.

Resolve guest concerns and unexpected issues with empathy and sound judgment.

Keep internal communication clear so schedules, updates, and tasks stay organized and on track.

Solve problems and smooth the way to a seamless guest experience.

Notice the patterns behind recurring problems, flag them early, and suggest practical fixes that make stays smoother for everyone.

Uphold Casa Oso's standard of thoughtful hosting so guests feel welcomed and supported throughout their stay.



Qualifications:

Fluent English, written and spoken.

Strong logical thinking and problem-solving.

Customer service experience in hospitality or a related industry.

Strong attention to detail — able to spot patterns and act before issues reach guests.

Able to communicate with warmth, clarity, and professionalism across different situations.

Proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Calendar).

Experience with Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, Hostaway, or similar platforms is a plus, but not required — we'll train you.

A knack for spotting what could go wrong and sharing simple fixes to keep every stay consistent and welcoming.

Calm, organized, and resourceful when a guest needs help.

Self-motivated and comfortable working independently.



Requirements:

Reliable computer.

Stable internet connection.



What We Offer:

Full training on our systems and processes.

Room to grow with a company that believes great stays come from preparation, detail, and genuine care.

A collaborative remote team that values initiative, accountability, and continuous improvement.



To Apply:

Please send your application to: 

Please use this exact subject line:

Guest Experience Specialist (Remote Host) — [Your Name]

Attention to detail matters here — applications that don't follow it may be overlooked.



Please include:

Your resume

Your expected hourly rate

Confirmation that you're available to work the shift hours listed above



A Quick Hosting Exercise:

Some of the most important parts of hosting happen through communication, so we'd love to see how you respond to guests.



Reply to the guest message below in your application
:



Guest Message:

"Hi there, we arrived about an hour ago and overall the house is lovely. We did notice a few things that weren't quite what we expected, including some crumbs under the dining table and a few dishes that didn't seem completely clean. We're not upset, but wanted to let you know."



There's no perfect answer — we just want to see how you communicate, solve problems, and help guests feel cared for when something's off.



What Happens Next:



Expected Start Date: Based on your availability — we're ready as soon as you are.

Our hiring process may include:

Application review

A short introductory video (we’ll request this once your application passes our first review)

Initial interview

Practical assessment or trial task

Final interview

If it feels like a good fit on both sides, we'll move quickly.

 opens, website visits) and firmographic fit to prioritize high-value prospects.

, LinkedIn, Content) designed to attract, engage, and delight B2B clients.

Inbound Knowledge: Strong understanding of inbound marketing methodologies and content-led lead generation.

Certifications: Active HubSpot Certifications (Marketing, Sales, and Reporting) are highly preferred.

Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of custom objects, API integrations, and advanced workflow logic.

Analytical Mindset: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and the ability to interpret complex data sets.

Detail-Oriented: A "zero-mistake" approach to data management and

This is a pivotal role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital infrastructure. You will work in a fast-paced environment where your work directly impacts revenue and the efficiency of the entire team.

title: Accounting Support
description:
We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Accounting Support (Property Finance & Tax Return) to support the financial management and regulatory compliance requirements of a large portfolio of multi-residential and commercial properties. This role is responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, managing taxation obligations, supporting payroll administration, and ensuring compliance across a complex portfolio of property entities. 



The successful candidate will work across multiple financial and compliance functions, including tax reporting, Business Activity Statements (BAS), Instalment Activity Statements (IAS), payroll administration, and superannuation compliance. This position is ideal for an experienced accounting or finance professional who thrives in a structured environment and is capable of managing high-volume, multi-entity financial portfolios with precision and efficiency. 



Responsibilities 



Property Financial Administration 



Portfolio Management: Support the financial administration and compliance requirements of a large portfolio of residential and commercial property entities. 



Financial Record Management: Maintain accurate financial records, supporting documentation, and compliance documentation across all managed entities. 



Tax Return Administration: Prepare and coordinate annual tax return documentation and lodgements for property entities within the portfolio. 



Taxation & Compliance 



Business Activity Statements (BAS): Prepare, review, and submit Business Activity Statements for GST-registered property entities. 



Instalment Activity Statements (IAS): Manage and lodge Instalment Activity Statements to ensure ongoing compliance with Australian taxation obligations. 



GST Monitoring: Monitor property entities for GST registration requirements and assess financial activity against relevant reporting thresholds. 



Regulatory Compliance: Ensure financial and taxation records are maintained in accordance with Australian regulatory requirements and reporting obligations. 



Payroll & Superannuation 



Payroll Administration: Process and manage payroll activities for building entities that directly employ caretaking or operational staff. 



Superannuation Compliance: Calculate, process, and maintain accurate records of superannuation contributions in accordance with Australian legislation. 



Payroll Reporting: Support payroll reporting requirements and maintain compliance with applicable payroll regulations and reporting standards. 



Systems & Reporting 



Strata Management Administration: Manage financial workflows, records, and reporting activities within the StrataMax platform. 



Financial Reporting: Assist with reconciliations, reporting, and financial analysis across multiple property entities. 



Data Integrity: Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial data, ensuring consistency across all systems and reporting platforms. 



Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reporting accuracy, and financial administration processes. 



Requirements 



Proven experience in bookkeeping, accounting, financial administration, or property finance within a multi-entity or portfolio-based environment.  



Demonstrated experience preparing and lodging Australian tax obligations, including BAS, IAS, and annual entity tax returns.  



Experience managing payroll administration and superannuation compliance.  



Strong understanding of Australian accounting principles, taxation requirements, and regulatory compliance frameworks.  



Experience managing high-volume financial portfolios across multiple entities simultaneously.  



Familiarity with property management, strata management, trust accounting, or similar property-related financial structures is highly regarded.  



Strong verbal and written English communication skills aligned with Australian professional standards.  



Advanced organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.  



Ability to work independently while managing competing deadlines and priorities.  



PART TIME: 20 hours per week

 



Software Proficiency 



Strata Management Software – StrataMax 



Payroll Software – Single Touch Payroll (STP) compliant platforms 



Productivity Tools – Microsoft Office Suite, including advanced Excel and Word 



Collaboration Tools – Google Workspace 



Education 



Bachelor’s Degree in Accountancy, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. 



CPA qualification or equivalent professional accounting certification will be highly regarded.
