title: Content Community Manager
description:
We are looking for a highly motivated Content Operations Manager who is passionate about youth development, digital media, and community engagement. This person will oversee our YouTube channel and Skool community while helping scale a brand that already has a large audience and a growing national presence.



This is more than a content posting job. We are looking for someone who thinks like an owner, takes initiative, and wants to build something meaningful that impacts thousands of young people and families.



Compensation



Starting Pay: $500 per month

Payday: The 15th of every month.

Monthly Performance Reviews: Every month your performance will be evaluated for a possible raise.

As the company grows, you grow with it.

This position has the opportunity to grow into a leadership role earning up to $10,000+ per month, based on performance, responsibilities, and the overall growth of the company.



Raises and bonuses are based on measurable results, including:



Growth in YouTube subscribers

Increased watch time and views

YouTube monetization and revenue growth

Increased engagement and retention inside the Skool community

Growth in Skool memberships

Consistent execution of daily responsibilities

Leadership, initiative, and ability to improve systems

Helping create new revenue opportunities for the organization



On call/Flexible Position

This is a results-driven role. We are not focused on tracking hours we’re focused on completing tasks with excellence, consistency, and ownership.



Primary Responsibilities



YouTube Operations

Edit long-form and short-form videos.

Upload and schedule YouTube videos.

Create engaging thumbnails, titles, descriptions, and keywords.

Optimize every video using YouTube SEO.

Monitor analytics and identify growth opportunities.

Increase subscribers, watch time, and monetization.

Repurpose content into Shorts and other social media platforms.



Skool Community Operations:



Post engaging content throughout the day.

Welcome new members.

Reply to comments and questions.

Create daily discussions, polls, challenges, and activities.

Increase member participation and retention.

Build a positive, active community culture.

Help members feel connected and supported.



Content Strategy



Brainstorm new content ideas.

Stay current with YouTube trends and algorithm changes.

Build systems that improve workflow and efficiency.

Help develop digital products and online educational experiences.

Collaborate with leadership on long-term growth strategies.



Qualifications



We’re looking for someone who:



Has experience editing videos professionally.

Understands YouTube growth, analytics, SEO, and monetization.

Has experience building and managing online communities.

Is familiar with Skool or is willing to become an expert quickly.

Has knowledge of mental health, youth development, mentoring, or behavioral health.

Are a strong leader and communicator.

Can work independently without constant supervision.

Is creative, organized, dependable, and solutions oriented.

Is passionate about changing lives and serving youth.



What Success Looks Like

Within your first few months, we want to see:



Consistent YouTube uploads.

Growth in subscribers, views, watch time, and revenue.

Daily engagement inside the Skool community.

Increased member activity and retention.

New ideas that improve our systems and brand.

Growth in both our digital reach and community impact.



Our Mission

Our mission is to empower, inspire, and educate youth to know the power within. We believe in building leaders, strengthening families, and creating lasting change in our communities.



We aren’t just hiring an employee we’re looking for someone who wants to help build a nationally recognized youth organization. If you’re driven, creative, and excited to grow alongside a mission with purpose, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Technical Onboarding Manager (Customer Success & Tech Support) - $900 Base + Performance Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- $900/month guaranteed base

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 3,600+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 8 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 8 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Customer Accounts & Order Operations Specialist — Zoho, Invoicing, AR & Process Improvement
description:
ABOUT US



A19 Artisan Lighting is a very small California-based manufacturer of handmade ceramic lighting. We create artisan wall sconces and ceiling fixtures for homes, designers, hospitality projects, and commercial spaces.



We are looking for a trustworthy, detail-oriented, systems-minded tea
mber to help with customer accounts, order entry, invoicing, accounts receivable, purchasing support, and daily operations.



This is not a basic VA role. We need someone who enjoys accuracy, systems, process improvement, and making messy work more organized and repeatable.



ROLE DETAILS



This is a long-term full-time role, ideally 30–40 hours per week. We are open to starting closer to 30 hours while training, with the goal of growing into a consistent full-time role if it is a good fit.



Starting compensation is $5.80/hr, with room to increase over time for someone who proves reliable, proactive, trustworthy, accurate, and able to take ownership.



ABOUT THE ROLE



You will help keep customer orders and accounts moving accurately while also helping us clean up and improve processes that have become messier than we are comfortable with.



You should enjoy improving systems, catching details, creating checklists, maintaining accuracy, and making work cleaner and easier to manage. You will not simply maintain what we already have, which to be honest, is a bit of a mess. We are looking for someone who likes the challenge of improving order-entry, customer-account, invoicing, and bookkeeping-adjacent workflows that need better organization, consistency, and follow-through.



Ideally, you have experience with Zoho One or are excited to learn it deeply. We want someone who can help us better use our business operating system and transition away from QuickBooks into Zoho 100% by year-end. Our current Zoho apps include Zoho Inventory, Zoho Books, Zoho Mail, Zoho CRM, Zoho Flow, Zoho Analytics, and related tools.



You have a high level of competency, strong judgment, and confidence implementing process improvements. You should also be comfortable coordinating regular check-ins and progress updates with me, the President of the company.



WHAT YOU"LL HELP WITH



• Manage or help manage the
 inbox

• Enter orders in Zoho Inventory

• Enter or mirror needed information in QuickBooks during our transition

• Prepare estimates, invoices, sales orders, and order confirmations

• Send customer statements and friendly payment follow-ups

• Help manage customer accounts and AR

• Support customer service through
 and occasional calls

• Help with purchasing and vendor follow-up

• Maintain accurate customer, order, invoice, and payment records

• Apply credits or correct clear pricing/account issues within agreed guidelines

• Create checklists, improve SOPs, and document recurring processes

• Identify bottlenecks and suggest and implement practical improvements

• Use AI and automation tools responsibly to draft, summarize, organize, and improve efficiency

• Provide regular progress updates and flag questions or process gaps





THE RIGHT PERSON IS



• Highly trustworthy

• Accurate and detail-oriented

• Organized and proactive

• Comfortable with customer-facing communication

• Systems-minded and tech savvy

• Confident improving processes

• Honest when something is unclear

• Willing to ask questions before guessing

• Interested in long-term work

• Comfortable working with a small business where things are improving but not yet perfect



You should enjoy making processes more organized, accurate, repeatable, and efficient.



HELPFUL EXPERIENCE

Helpful experience includes, but is not limited to:



• Zoho Books, Zoho Inventory, Zoho CRM, or similar systems

• QuickBooks or bookkeeping support

• Order entry, invoicing, AR, or purchasing

• Customer account management

•
 support

• Spreadsheets

• SOPs, checklists, or process documentation

• AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude



Interest in interior design, lighting, home décor, architecture, handmade products, or artisan goods is a strong plus.



HOW WE'LL START



We will begin with a paid trial project before expanding into ongoing work.



The trial may include watching a short order-entry screen recording, repeating the process with sample information, drafting a customer confirmation
, reviewing a sample account, or creating/improving an order-entry checklist.



HOW TO APPLY



Please reply with:



1. Why this role interests you

2. An example of a messy process, account system, spreadsheet, or workflow you helped improve

3. Your weekly availability during U.S. Pacific Time business hours

4. The phrase “I’m ready to lighten the load” so I know you read the full post



Please do not send a generic application. We are looking for someone careful, honest, thoughtful, and genuinely interested in helping a small handmade lighting company become more organized, accurate, and efficient.



Thank you in advance!

A clear note on your hands-on experience with each of the four required tools: Photoshop, Illustrator, Nano Banana 2, and GPT Image 2



To confirm you've read the full posting, please include the phrase "I'm Nano Bananas About Ireland and Scotland" somewhere in your introduction.

title: Meta Media Buyer (Campaign Optimization & AI Creatives)
description:
KeepUpMedia is a North American marketing agency for premium medical clinics. I run our paid advertising and launch every campaign myself — I'm hiring a media buyer to be the hands inside our ad accounts that keep those campaigns sharp after launch.



To be clear up front: this is NOT a strategy or campaign-launch role. I lead the advertising and tell you what needs to happen. Your job is to go into the accounts and execute it cleanly and on time. If you're reliable, fast, and AI-native, this is a long-term seat with real room to grow.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Iterate on live campaigns: swap in new creatives and adjust budgets, audiences, and settings exactly as I direct.

- Update Meta Instant Forms, including specific conditional logic.

- Monitor all ad accounts every 72 hours and deliver a clean end-of-3-day report. This cadence cannot slip.

- Use Higgsfield (through Claude's MCP connection) to produce static ad creatives for last-minute client requests.

- Download new ad assets and load them into campaigns — fast and error-free.

- Execute the day-to-day changes I assign. You're the hands in the account, not the strategist.



YOU MUST HAVE

- Strong, hands-on Meta Ads Manager experience — campaign structure, creatives, forms, and troubleshooting. You work confidently inside accounts while taking direction from me.

- Daily AI fluency. A Claude MCP connection to Higgsfield is the single most important skill for this role — mention your experience with it specifically. If you don't use Claude, please don't apply.

- Higgsfield experience (I'll provide an account with credits, so that's covered).

- Fast, reliable internet — you'll be downloading and uploading creative constantly.

- Strong written English to follow detailed instructions and write clear reports, plus solid conversational English for our weekly sync.

- Total reliability on deadlines, especially the 72-hour monitoring cycle.



BONUS POINTS

- Agency, medical, or lead-gen advertising experience.

- Familiarity with GoHighLevel / LeadConnector.

- A good eye for clean, on-brand static creative.



THE SETUP

- Part-time, around 15 hours/week to start, scaling as we add clients.

- $15/hour.

- Higgsfield account and credits provided.

- Direction comes from me; one weekly sync, everything else async.



TO APPLY

Start your message with the word "STATIC" so I know you read this in full. Then tell me: (1) your hands-on Meta Ads Manager experience and the trickiest problem you've solved inside an account, (2) your experience using Claude and MCP connections (and Higgsfield, if you have it), and (3) how you'd structure a 72-hour ad-account monitoring report.

title: Setter / Closer
description:
Setter / Closer



Outlead Me | Remote (Philippines) | $300 USD/month | Full-Time





About Outlead Me



Outlead Me is a done-for-you client acquisition agency. We build and run outbound systems for B2B service businesses — handling lead generation, CRM setup,
 campaigns, and ongoing pipeline management so our clients never have to worry about it.



We're a remote-first team built on three things: execution, ownership, and measurable results. If you want a role where you deliver real outcomes and grow fast, keep reading.





The Role



You're the closer who turns warm leads into signed contracts.



You'll take qualified leads from our Marketing Specialist, conduct discovery calls via Zoom, qualify prospects, present our service offering, handle objections, and close deals. At launch, you'll handle both setting appointment confirmations and closing — as volume grows, these will split.



This is a high-visibility role reporting directly to our Co-Founder/Sales Manager. Every deal you close directly impacts our revenue.





What You'll Own



Call Management





Receive warm leads from the Marketing Specialist with full briefing notes

Reach out via
 or LinkedIn to confirm and lock in discovery calls

Conduct 30-minute discovery calls via Zoom using our proven Discovery Call Framework

Qualify every prospect against our ICP (company type, size, revenue, decision-maker, pain point)





Closing





Present Outlead Me's service offering clearly using our Execution Plan Template

Handle common objections (cost, timing, contract length) with provided scripts

Ask for the close and actually finish the deal

Send proposals and contracts within 24 hours of a positive call

Follow up on all open proposals within 48 hours — never let a deal go cold





Operations





Log all call outcomes and deal stages in the CRM same day — no delays

Report weekly to founders: calls completed, qualified leads, proposals sent, deals closed

Maintain professional communication and represent Outlead Me on every call







You Have This Background





Confident, professional spoken English — comfortable on video calls with business owners from US, Australia, UK, Canada

B2B sales or appointment setting experience — you know how to qualify and close

Structured sales approach — you follow a framework without sounding robotic

Comfortable handling objections — you know when to push and when to listen

Strong written English — clear follow-up
s and proposal delivery

Reliable setup — good internet, professional Zoom background, quality audio/video

CRM experience — you keep deals updated accurately and on time

Bonus: B2B service sales experience (agency, consulting, SaaS)







Who We're Looking For (Values Fit)



We hire for character first. You align with these if you thrive here:



? Closer mentality — you're not afraid to ask for the close; you finish the job



? Disciplined — you follow up on every open proposal, every time



? Own your metrics — you take responsibility for your close rate and push to improve it



? Professional presence — you represent us well on every call; no improvisation that damages trust



? Clear communication — you keep founders in the loop; no deals sit in ambiguity



? Coachable — you're eager to improve and take feedback seriously





The Process



1. Application



Submit via OnlineJobs.ph with subject: [Setter / Closer] — [Your Name]



Include a 2-minute Loom video:





Introduce yourself

Explain why this role is the right fit

Show your personality and confidence





2. Trial Task



We assess real-world performance, not just interviews.



Deliverable: Record a 5-minute Loom video of yourself conducting a mock discovery call.



You'll receive:





Brief on a fictional prospect (company type, size, pain point)

Discovery questions to follow





Show us:





English fluency and clarity

Confidence on camera

Structured thinking

Whether you'd actually close this deal





3. Conversation



If the trial task shows promise, we'll talk through your sales approach and fit.





Onboarding Timeline





Days 1–2: Access to CRM and all sales materials. Review Discovery Call Framework and objection scripts.

Days 3–5: Listen to recorded discovery calls from the founder. Practice the framework via role-play.

Week 2: First live discovery calls under supervision. Founder observes and debriefs after each.

Week 3: Fully independent on discovery calls. All outcomes logged in CRM same day.

Month 1: Running the full sales cycle independently — from call confirmation to signed contract.







Our Operating Values



Execution Over Excuses



Ship. Deliver. Hit deadlines. Fix, don't explain.



Owned Outcomes



Everyone owns their output fully. No blame.



Systems Before Scale



Never grow faster than your ability to deliver.



Client Visibility



Weekly reports on time, every week. Silence is never acceptable.



Train to Delegate



Document everything. Knowledge is a team asset.



Hire for Values, Train for Skills



Character first in every hire.
